meaning_paraphrase: The world-process carries ideas and ideals; without them it would seem empty of purpose.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing life as guided by ideas and ideals, so that the world has a purpose

meaning_paraphrase: Reason can read the ordering ideas that are actually present in the outer world.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: trusting clear reasoning to find the order that is really there in the world

meaning_paraphrase: What is real is what can be grasped in number, measure and form.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: trusting what can be counted, measured and given a shape

meaning_paraphrase: The world is built up of matter and its material forces.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing the world as built from matter and its forces

meaning_paraphrase: Only what the senses deliver counts as knowledge.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: trusting only what the senses show

meaning_paraphrase: We know appearances; the world is given to us as phenomena.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: taking the world as it appears to us

meaning_paraphrase: Things are as they present themselves; the perceived world is real.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: taking things to be what they seem, so that the world we perceive is real

meaning_paraphrase: Forces working behind the phenomena are the true reality.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: looking for the forces at work behind what we see

meaning_paraphrase: The world consists of individual centres of being (monads).
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing the world as made of many individual centres of being

meaning_paraphrase: The world consists of many spiritual beings.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing the world as peopled by many spiritual beings

meaning_paraphrase: Spirit is a single unity pervading all things.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing one spirit running through everything

meaning_paraphrase: The world is ensouled; soul-beings stand behind the phenomena.
source: Steiner, Human and Cosmic Thought (GA 151), lecture 3, Berlin 22 Jan 1914
plain: seeing the world as alive with soul, with soul-beings behind what happens
